description:
**EARTHWATCH – The Ground Speaks**

EARTHWATCH is an interactive Earth observation platform powered by NASA-ISRO NISAR datasets. It transforms complex radar observations into understandable scientific insights through geospatial analysis, interactive visualizations, and an integrated AI assistant that explains detected surface changes. Users can explore datasets, compare observations, and interact with a 3D information station to better understand Earth's evolving surface.

details:
What It Does & How It Works:

EARTHWATCH is an accessible fire prediction and early-warning web application powered by NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) data. The platform ingests open-access radar datasets—specifically soil dryness and vegetation surface changes—and automatically translates complex scientific telemetry into clear, everyday language directly on the website. Users can immediately assess their area through a simple color-coded risk dashboard (Green: Safe, Red: Active Danger) and explore an interactive Before-and-After map that visualizes predicted fire spread zones alongside safe evacuation routes. Additionally, an optional, on-demand 24/7 AI assistant ("Ask EARTH WATCH agent") is embedded directly on the screen for users who want to ask specific questions about their neighborhood or request personalized safety guidance.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

By eliminating the need for technical expertise to read raw satellite radar maps, EARTHWATCH democratizes life-saving NASA Earth observation data. Because it operates entirely as a responsive web application without requiring expensive street hardware, it delivers real-time fire predictions directly to citizens' smartphones and computers anywhere. Its intended impact is to replace public panic with clear visual guidance, accelerate evacuation times before fires spread, and minimize casualties and property damage.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used:

• Satellite Data & APIs: NASA Earthdata, Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF DAAC) Vertex Portal, Global NISAR Soil Moisture Product, and NASA FIRMS datasets.

• Web Development: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to build a fast, responsive, cross-device interface and interactive Before-and-After map visualization.

• AI & Conversational Integration: ASTRO AI Gateway (CoreX AI) integrated via embedded web widgets and REST APIs to power the "Ask EARTH WATCH agent" assistant.

• Design & Presentation: Canva for UI/UX prototyping, visual mockups, and presentation design.

Creativity & Key Factors Considered:

• User-Centered Simplicity: Instead of forcing panicked users to type into a chatbot during an emergency, our creative approach displays simplified NISAR insights and Green/Red alerts visually at a glance, keeping the AI agent as an optional tool for deeper inquiries.

• Visual Before-and-After Storytelling: Comparing predicted risk zones ("Before") with active impact and safe routes ("After") helps everyday citizens intuitively grasp spatial danger.

• Accessibility & Scalability: We prioritized mobile responsiveness, high-contrast color coding, plain-language translation, and zero-hardware deployment so the platform can scale rapidly to high-risk communities across Egypt and the globe.
